_comment: Hand-reviewed analyses for forms Morpheus does not know. Single and double letters are Aristotle's variable labels in the Book V discussion of proportion (1131a-1133b) and similar passages; they are labels, not words.

a.gloss: the letter Α used as a label (term in a proportion)

b.gloss: the letter Β used as a label (term in a proportion)

g.gloss: the letter Γ used as a label (term in a proportion)

d.gloss: the letter Δ used as a label (term in a proportion)

e.gloss: the letter Ε used as a label (term in a proportion)

z.gloss: the letter Ζ used as a label (term in a proportion)

aa.gloss: the line/segment ΑΑ (pair of labelled terms)

bb.gloss: the line/segment ΒΒ (pair of labelled terms)

gg.gloss: the line/segment ΓΓ (pair of labelled terms)

gd.gloss: the line/segment ΓΔ (pair of labelled terms)
